title: Maker spread capture on a mid-liquidity USDT-M perp band
distinctness: Single variable vs CRYPTO-005 is the instrument liquidity tier. Quote policy, fill rule, VIP0 2bps maker fee, markout horizons, 1000 USD notional and 2% participation cap are held IDENTICAL. CRYPTO-005 S6 explicitly prescribed this follow-up ('wider-spread/less-liquid instrument where quoted spread clears the fee'). Not directional OHLCV, not bar-close constant-bps, so not in the Absorbing Exclusion Registry.

band.ranks_1_50_excluded_reason: that is the CRYPTO-005 fee-dominated regime, already measured
band.selection: uniform stride band[i*floor(len/20)] for i in 0..19

revenue_object: half-spread net of maker fee and 60s markout
edge_definition: net_edge_bps_per_fill = captured_half_spread_bps - maker_fee_bps + markout60_bps; markout signed positive when price drifts in the resting inventory's favour
proxy_limitation: Trade-tape top-of-book reversal proxy (Vision has NO historical bookTicker/depth; verified 2026-09-22 against S3 listing data/spot/monthly/). Overestimates maker PnL: blind to sub-trade quoted spread, queue position, cancel latency. Fail-closed: proxy-negative rejects at evidence grade; proxy-positive certifies nothing and only justifies paid-L2 acquisition.

G1_structural_spread_gt_fee.requirement: captured_half_spread_bps > maker_fee_bps for >= 50% of sampled symbols
G1_structural_spread_gt_fee.rationale: spread must exceed the toll before any markout luck is admitted

G2_net_edge_positive.requirement: median net edge per fill > 0 across symbols AND per-symbol block-bootstrap 95% LB > 0 at h=60s for >= 60% of symbols

G3_capacity.rationale: a wide spread nobody crosses is not an edge

G4_no_day_concentration.requirement: pnl must not derive from < 30% of probe days

G5_execution_realism.requirement: quotes respect venue tickSize and MIN_NOTIONAL; fills capped at 2% participation

honest_prior_recorded_before_measurement: On BTCUSDT the fee/spread ratio was ~40x; the mid band must scale harvestable half-spread from ~0.05bps to >~2bps to clear. Mid-cap perp quoted spreads plausibly 5-30bps, so the test is borderline and the ex-ante expectation leans toward rejection. Recorded so that a later result cannot be read as having been assumed.

data_contract.manifest: sha256 per file, recorded before any edge computation

probe_register.allowed_data: in-sample months only; OOS partition never opened
probe_register.confirmed: CRYPTO-005 diagnosis transfers: harvestable spread is ~130x wider on ranks 51-150 than on BTCUSDT (2.39 vs 0.018 bps), so the 2bps VIP0 maker fee stops being mechanically binding. Mechanism not disproven.
probe_register.reason_for_rejection: corr(half_spread, net_edge)=0.967 with an instrument whose upward bias is proportional to spread width; apparent edge lives entirely in the illiquid half (median 90d volume $2.10B vs $3.81B for the negative half) where a reversal gap is price impact not reclaimable spread; every depth-capable name is net negative. G2b is a boundary failure (10/20 vs frozen threshold 12) and the threshold is not moved.
probe_register.g3_caveat: G3 passes but tests fill COUNT, which the proxy over-counts by ignoring cancel latency and queue position. Not evidence of capacity; do not cite as a passed feasibility result.
probe_register.escalation_recommendation: AGAINST paid L2 acquisition. L2 sharpens the gross-spread term the proxy already overstates, so its expected effect is to confirm rejection; it cannot repair G2b. Cost decision reserved to the human.
probe_register.absorbing_scope: CRYPTO-006 as registered: reversal proxy, ranks 51-150, VIP0 maker fee
legitimate_distinct_followups_not_endors: fee-regime hypothesis on a maker-rebate tier (changes economics, not measurement)
queue-position-explicit L2 hypothesis with fills derived from book dynamics, not tape reversals (fixes the instrument)
probe_register.reproduction_check: Re-measuring BTCUSDT with this probe gives mean net edge -2.07 bps against CRYPTO-005's sealed -2.04 bps.
probe_register.portfolio_effect: no change; qualified_variants unchanged; no capital deployed; promotion gate has now refused 41 candidates

terminal_outcomes: probe_gated_rejection -> absorb under ADR-029 with AGENTS rule 8 classification
gate_pass -> separate proposal for paid historical L2 + shadow-only deployment, new ADR required
